'''Wisco''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was present on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in [[3627 BBY]], where he sold items to travellers.
